standard_prerequisites.use: Formation of M(C), normalized quaternionic matrix with basis minors 0 or1 and quaternionic Cauchy-Binet are prior algebraic inputs; identifying its stable complex determinant with h_M squared remains the task.

standard_prerequisites.name: Stable determinant polynomials and polynomial identity principle
standard_prerequisites.reference: Classical positive-semidefinite determinantal stability; stability definitions110–127
standard_prerequisites.use: Determinant of a full-rank complex Gram pencil is stable, and equality on positive orthant implies polynomial equality.

core_obligations: Construct the complex Gram determinant attached to a normalized quaternionic representation and identify its polynomial with the square of the unweighted matroid basis polynomial.
Use quaternionic Cauchy-Binet, multiplicativity and positive-orthant scaling to pass from quaternionic minors to the complex determinant and transfer stability through the square.

compared.difference: Public item609 is Theorem3.3 on real-zero amalgamation forcing polymatroid amalgamation. The new theorem treats all quaternionic unimodular matroids via a Gram determinant, has different hypotheses and conclusion and is neither an alternative amalgamation proof nor its direct corollary.
